configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build with ONNX Runtime backend

configurePresets.name: debug-sanitizers
configurePresets.description: Debug build with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer

configurePresets.name: debug-tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with ThreadSanitizer (data-race detection). Mutually exclusive with SANITIZERS and STRICT_UBSAN.

configurePresets.name: debug-strict-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with additional UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer checks. Mutually exclusive with SANITIZERS and THREAD_SANITIZER.

configurePresets.name: debug-valgrind
configurePresets.description: Plain Debug build (no sanitizers) for Valgrind memcheck/profiling. Enables the memcheck/callgrind/massif targets.

configurePresets.name: gpu-pipeline
configurePresets.displayName: GPU pipeline (TensorRT + CUDA preprocess + CUDA postprocess)
configurePresets.description: TensorRT backend with the full GPU pipeline: CUDA kernel + nvJPEG preprocessing and CUDA segmentation postprocessing. Needs nvcc and the CUDA Toolkit's nvJPEG; TensorRT resolves from -DTENSORRT_ROOTDIR or is downloaded by the dependency resolver.

configurePresets.name: gpu-pipeline-dali
configurePresets.displayName: GPU pipeline (TensorRT + DALI preprocess + CUDA postprocess)
configurePresets.description: The gpu-pipeline preset with DALI as the alternative preprocessor. Stage DALI first (./scripts/fetch_dali.sh); override DALI_ROOT/TENSORRT_ROOTDIR if not under ~/dependencies.
